title: Anyone can use miyagi-cloud as free AI
solution: Server-side per-install, per-user and global spend caps, a runtime kill switch and alerts in miyagi-cloud, plus the fixes in Michael's private notes.

title: No provider-side spend caps or alerts
solution: In the consoles today: a dedicated Anthropic workspace with a spend limit and alerts, an org limit, a Gemini project cap and budget alerts, and correct prices in the proxy.

title: No consent before screen capture, and no AI disclosure
solution: A plain consent screen before the Screen Recording prompt, an "AI, can be wrong" line, and the providers named in the app and on the site.

title: No live privacy policy or terms
solution: Publish the corrected drafts at /privacy and /terms, fix the app's dead links, add a first-run "I agree" step, and have a lawyer read them before public launch.

title: Correct work marked wrong, then the coach says to change working code
solution: Grade runs on the newest output only, check shape instead of literals, accept any terminal, and let the coach say "your code works".

title: Nobody has installed the launch build on a clean Mac
solution: Swap the public releases to a versioned v2 build and run Test 1 on clean macOS 15, 26 and 27 VMs before anyone outside installs.

title: Lesson builds through miyagi-cloud may fail
solution: Grep an engine log today, then give the lesson-build role its own token cap and make the model allowlist match the Gemini decision.

title: Placeholder: VS Code companion configuration and engine handling of learner keys
solution: Apply the fixes in Michael's private notes, ship companion 0.0.7, and hide own-key fields until the engine fix ships.

title: Gemini's terms bar under-18 users and under-18 account holders
solution: Recommended: Claude only for everyone at launch, with Gemini off in the cloud and in Settings, keeping the 13+ gate.

title: No way to get a fix to installed users, and one personal account controls releases
solution: Versioned immutable releases, the update card with a pinned installer URL, a signed manifest on miyagi.study, and a minimum-version answer from the cloud.

title: The founders are minors with no entity, so accounts need an adult
solution: A parent holds and pays for every vendor account and enrolls with Apple now; a lawyer consult on an LLC with a parent as manager before taking money.

title: New installs may be refused on launch day
solution: Test the client-IP handling on a staging Render service, raise the per-IP install limit with plain copy, and move the app to api.miyagi.study and net.fetch.

title: The site offers a Windows download that can't run a lesson
solution: Remove the Windows button for launch ("mac only for now") and mark the windows release as Mac-only.

title: Progress and settings get lost
solution: Serve the renderer from a fixed origin, make Continue restore the saved step without moving files, and move the hero lesson out of the engine tree.

title: The Mac app is unsigned
solution: A parent enrolls with Apple, then Developer ID and notarization with the bundled-Python entitlements; until then, a first-launch capture check with re-grant steps.

title: miyagi-cloud capacity, provider tiers and plan
solution: Confirm Starter with the disk, raise the Anthropic tier, lift the connection-pool limits, lighten scene looks and load-test before launch.

title: Screen capture takes more than the lesson needs
solution: Exclude private and messaging apps on every capture path and scrub secrets from code and files; capture only the editor and tutorial windows after launch.

title: Google sign-in and Supabase aren't launch-ready
solution: Publish the Google app, check the Supabase console, fix the sign-in copy and button, and brand the consent screen with a custom domain or a desktop client.

title: No age gate or minors safeguards
solution: A neutral age gate before sign-in that stores only an age band, teen defaults, Anthropic's child-safety prompt and a public COPPA statement.

title: One-click model-written commands, and a shared lesson cache that could feed them
solution: Keep the shared cache out of the launch build, and make Run it for me show the command and refuse dangerous ones.

title: The engine scrapes YouTube for transcripts
solution: Recommended: keep the on-device fetch with limits (no server scraping, no Bright Data, no spoofed agent, nothing stored) after a lawyer's read; build toward creator captions.

title: Name collision with Miyagi Labs, and Karate Kid cues
solution: Drop every Karate Kid cue now and get a clearance opinion before the public post; rebrand before posting if it comes back high-risk.

title: Delete my data is misleading, and nothing deletes on the server
solution: Honest button copy now, then a full app erase, DELETE /v1/me with Supabase user deletion, retention limits and unlink on sign-out.

title: Spinners and builds with no way out
solution: An app watchdog and socket heartbeat, a hard deadline on every model call and on the whole build, and progress by stage.

title: Raw or wrong errors when the cloud or a provider fails
solution: Map every cloud and provider failure to one calm card, keep minting while paused, and retry the first mint with backoff.

title: First run on a real student's Mac
solution: Set the network probe to the cloud host, suggest a lesson that can't fail, make Accessibility optional, and fix the VS Code, venv and proxy cases.

title: Wrong work marked right
solution: The judge can never overrule a failing machine check (before launch); mask comments and grade the newest run (after).

title: Local access hardening for the engine, companion and app (mostly placeholder)
solution: Apply the fixes in Michael's private notes, isolate the YouTube player from the app bridge, and bump Electron to the latest 45.x.

title: No support, security or privacy contact
solution: Domain email to a shared inbox, private vulnerability reporting, security.txt and SECURITY.md, a no-upload bug form, /help and a rehearsed runbook.

title: Launch-day blindness: no crash, usage or uptime signal
solution: Uptime monitors today, server-side counters with no content, an opt-in fixed-schema crash endpoint, and no SDK without the allowlist config.

title: Copy over-promises, the demo is scripted, and it can read as a cheating tool
solution: Say exactly what works today, add "can be wrong" and "beta", record one honest unedited take, and position it as checking work, never doing it.

title: macOS permission prompts: the monthly re-ask and the 27.3 change
solution: Pause the lesson with a plain card when macOS re-asks, name the monthly alert in onboarding, and rewrite the Accessibility step for 27.3.

title: The download code gate
solution: Keep it for the private beta and remove it on public launch morning, once the spend controls are live.

title: Personal accounts are single points of failure
solution: Verify miyagi.study on GitHub Pages, put Porkbun on 2FA and auto-renew with a parent's card, and give a second person Render access.

title: Where miyagi is offered
solution: Recommended: US first, blocking the EEA, UK, Switzerland and Anthropic's unsupported regions at the proxy until there's an entity.

title: Creators' content in the public repo, and no DMCA agent
solution: Take third-party lesson content out of the repo, register a DMCA agent with a takedown policy, and credit the creator in every lesson.

title: The site doesn't say what miyagi is, and an old app build is public at /live/
solution: One plain hero sentence, a desktop-app note on phones, delete /live/, load the YouTube embed on click, and add integrity hashes.

title: Launch channel rules
solution: Post from an account that passes /showlim, write every post and reply by hand, never ask for votes, and stagger HN and Product Hunt.

title: The engine keeps running with no UI
solution: Check on a Mac that capture stops when the app dies, make the engine exit with its parent, and have the app kill the group at quit.

title: Local logs keep questions, code and paths forever
solution: Private file modes, a rotated metadata-only log, ORCH_RECORD=0 in shipped builds, and a scrubbed Copy details.

title: Keep secrets out of the repo and builds
solution: Confirm secret scanning and push protection, run gitleaks in CI, refuse secret Supabase keys at build time, and scan every release asset.

title: Fixed ports 8787 and 47217
solution: Name the app holding port 8787 and let Retry work without a relaunch; choose ports at launch later.

title: No license choice and no third-party notices
solution: Choose a license on purpose, generate third-party notices at build time, ship OFL.txt, and check the bundled Python for GPL code.

title: Site polish: load weight, accessibility, a second download button
solution: Words before 3D, darker small text and a skip link, and a download block after the story.
